Allah is As-Salam; the young, the rider, the walker and the smaller group greet first; spread the greeting to known and unknown, and the better of two estranged greets first.
Anas greeted boys as the Prophet did, the companions greeted an old woman who fed them after the Friday prayer, and Gabriel sent his greeting to Aisha.

Aisha returned Gabriel's greeting; the Prophet greeted a mixed gathering including Abdullah bin Ubai; Ka'b doubted his greeting was returned during the boycott; Jews' greetings are answered 'And on you'.
When Jews greeted the Prophet with 'death be upon you', he forbade killing the one who said it, told Aisha to be gentle, and taught replying 'and upon you'.
